summary: Git and leading coding-agent products use worktrees to isolate parallel file state. Full task isolation additionally requires separate runtime resources, secrets and cleanup policy.

items.text: Git worktree: attaches multiple working trees to one repository so each agent can operate on a separate checked-out branch.
OpenAI Codex worktrees: isolated workspaces allow parallel tasks without changing the user's active checkout.
Claude Code --worktree: starts a session in an isolated Git worktree and supports worktree lifecycle hooks.
Cursor parallel agents: worktree-based isolation underpins concurrent agent changes before integration.
